pages.name: Record 1 - Text Only
pages.text:
Record of the lost and missing — Village of Barovia
Kept by Kolyan Indirovich

Dating convention: the first night of the siege is Night 1. Each night runs from dusk to the following dawn.



Doru, son of Father Donavich; young man of the village, and Mary's daughter's betrothed
status: missing; presumed dead
last seen: roughly three months before Night 1, departing in daylight from the eastern edge of the village for Castle Ravenloft. Departure witnessed by the burgomaster and many villagers.
how lost: Led a company of about two dozen villagers against the castle. None returned; no bodies were recovered and no word has been received.

Alanik Ray, adult visiting scholar and lodger at the burgomaster's mansion
status: missing; presumed dead
last seen: the same day as Doru, departing for Castle Ravenloft with Doru's company.
how lost: He had lodged at the mansion for several weeks to study Barovian history and ecology, and joined the march at Doru's urging. No one from the company returned.

Escher, young adult village bard and Doru's oldest friend
status: missing; presumed dead
last seen: departing with Doru's company for Castle Ravenloft, roughly three months before Night 1.
how lost: Helped Doru assemble the marchers and joined the company. None returned; no bodies were recovered and no word has been received.

Other members of Doru's company, mostly young adults
status: missing; presumed dead
last seen: departing with Doru and Alanik for Castle Ravenloft, roughly three months before Night 1.
how lost: None returned and no bodies were found. The company numbered about two dozen; the precise count is uncertain.

pages.text:
Record of the lost and missing — Village of Barovia
Kept by Kolyan Indirovich

Dating convention: the first night of the siege is Night 1. Each night runs from dusk to the following dawn.


Anton Konstantinovich, Alenka Konstantinova's brother
status: missing
last seen: at home before retiring on Night 4, according to Alenka.
how lost: Alenka reported him missing on the morning after Night 4. The door was undisturbed; no blood, signs of struggle, or body were found. Cause and manner of disappearance unknown.

Dezdrelda Konstaninova, Anton's wife
status: missing
last seen: at home with Anton before retiring on Night 4, according to Alenka.
how lost: Reported missing with her husband on the morning after Night 4. The door was undisturbed; no blood, signs of struggle, or body were found. Cause and manner of disappearance unknown.

Marta, adult sister of Bildrath Cantemir
status: dead
last seen: at home with her husband and son on Night 4.
how lost: According to Bildrath, she chose to stay and defend her home. Killed during the Night 4 attacks.

Dragomir, adult husband of Marta; father of Parriwimple
status: dead
last seen: at home with Marta and their son on Night 4.
how lost: Killed during the Night 4 attacks. Parriwimple survived and is in Bildrath's care.

pages.name: Record 5 - Text Only
pages.text:
Record of the lost and missing — Village of Barovia
Kept by Ismark Indirovich


Kolyan Indirovich, older adult burgomaster of Barovia; father of Ismark Kolyanovich & Ireena Kolyanovich (adopted)
status: dead
last seen alive: Night 7, at the mansion. Ireena heard him invite a visitor inside before her memory of the night failed.
how lost: Found dead in the first-floor parlor. Kolyan bore one long, clean cut across the chest. Ireena was found unconscious in the same room, alive, with two puncture wounds at her throat. Her account describes a tall, gaunt figure with a deep voice and red eyes. Cause of death: fatal chest wound. Perpetrator unidentified; Strahd is suspected, unconfirmed.

Other villagers and defenders killed in the siege, mixed ages, dozens by rough count
status: dead
last seen: at the barricades, in their homes, and in the streets over the course of the siege.
how lost: Killed in the attacks. Many bodies were visible when the western barricade fell. The exact total remains a rough count.

The undead withdrew after Kolyan's death. The siege ended on Night 7.



Gertruda, Mary's young adult daughter and Doru's betrothed
status: missing
last seen: at home with her mother on Night 6, before they retired, according to Mary. Mary found her gone at dawn after Night 6; the family horse, Nori, was also missing from its stall.
how lost: Mary believed Gertruda had set out alone for Vallaki to seek aid from its burgomaster. Scouts sent to search the western road on the morning after Night 6. Recorded as missing.

Lansten family: two adults and three children (one girl and two boys)
status: missing
last seen: during a zombie attack on Night 7; exact location not recorded.
how lost: Their disappearance was reported on the morning after Night 7. Their fate is unknown.

transcription.text:
In some shadowed corners of the world, the vampire reigns as a fearsome predator. Beyond mere bloodlust, these creatures are cursed with a range of abilities and weaknesses that make them as enigmatic as they are terrifying.

Their bodies are resilient to mundane weapons, shrugging off blows that would fell most mortals and regenerating even grievous wounds in a matter of moments. They move with unnatural grace, their senses sharply attuned to the whispers of the night. But it is in their supernatural abilities that their true horror lies. They can bend the will of others to their own, ensnaring friend and foe with but a gaze and a whisper. They can shift form with the ease of thought, becoming bats, wolves, or even a sinister mist that creeps beneath doorways and through cracks. And those their fangs kill become vampire spawn-ravenous creatures with a vampire's hunger for blood.

These creatures are not wholly invincible, however, possessing a tapestry of strengths woven with fatal weaknesses. Sunlight and running water can end their cursed existence, and wooden stakes through the heart will paralyze them as they sleep. They recoil from the sight of certain holy symbols, and cannot enter a residence without an invitation. They bear neither shadow nor reflection, and must return to their coffins, crypts, or graves to rest by day.

It is said that the bloodlust of these creatures is an unquenchable fire that burns within their undead hearts. The young and newly turned are slaves to this craving, often losing themselves in a frenzy at the mere scent of blood. But those who have walked the night for centuries, as well as those with indomitable focus and will, may learn to temper this fire. Those who do so possess the rare ability to conceal their monstrous nature, retracting and exposing their fangs at will-a sign that the monster within is held at bay, if only while the vampire allows.

To create a new vampire, a vampire must fully drain the blood of its victim without killing it-a torturous and careful process that can often take multiple nights. For some vampires, this process is a practical means of creating fresh and powerful thralls; for others, it presents a sadistic opportunity to slowly break their victim's will. Some vampires in the latter camp may even appear as an intermittent predator in the night, haunting their target over days or weeks before finally ending their suffering.

78

transcription.text:
14 June 636
We have accepted a contract from Barovia. A nobleman named Strahd von Zarovich is said to be suffering from a corruption tied to the land itself. Our objective is to investigate and, if possible, cure him.

16 June 636
We have entered Barovia.
The land is wrong. Distances do not remain consistent, and the road behind us is no longer reliable.
Locals speak of Strahd with fear. Not as a man who can be reached easily, but as something absolute within this place.

17 June 636
The mist does not lift. It does not behave like weather. It persists regardless of time or direction.
We attempted to chart the roads. The map becomes unreliable within hours. Paths do not match memory.

We are no longer certain how long we have been traveling.
Attempts to leave result in returning to familiar ground. There is no clear boundary, only repetition.
We continue toward our objective.

18 June 636
A structure has been located deep within the forest.

A large house stands alone where no settlement should exist. It is intact despite its surroundings.

We were seen before we approached.

The inhabitants appeared welcoming.

They invited us in for dinner.

We accepted.

at a formal reception. Castle Ravenloft
6 o'clock p.m.
13 September, 351
Dinner and refreshments to be served.

transcription.text:
My most pathetic servant,

I am not a messiah sent to you by the Dark Powers of this land. I have not come to lead you on a path to immortality. However many souls you have bled on your hidden altar, however many visitors you have tortured in your dungeon, know that you are not the ones who brought me to this beautiful land. You are but worms writhing in my earth.

You say that you are cursed, your fortunes spent. You abandoned love for madness, took solace in the bosom of another woman, and sired a stillborn son. Cursed by darkness? Of that I have no doubt. Save you from your wretchedness? I think not. I much prefer you as you are.

Your dread lord and master,
Strahd von Zarovich

transcription.text:
Record of the lost and missing — Village of Barovia
Kept by Kolyan Indirovich

Dating convention: the first night of the siege is Night 1. Each night runs from dusk to the following dawn.



Doru, son of Father Donavich; young man of the village, and Mary's daughter's betrothed
status: missing; presumed dead
last seen: roughly three months before Night 1, departing in daylight from the eastern edge of the village for Castle Ravenloft. Departure witnessed by the burgomaster and many villagers.
how lost: Led a company of about two dozen villagers against the castle. None returned; no bodies were recovered and no word has been received.

Alanik Ray, adult visiting scholar and lodger at the burgomaster's mansion
status: missing; presumed dead
last seen: the same day as Doru, departing for Castle Ravenloft with Doru's company.
how lost: He had lodged at the mansion for several weeks to study Barovian history and ecology, and joined the march at Doru's urging. No one from the company returned.

Escher, young adult village bard and Doru's oldest friend
status: missing; presumed dead
last seen: departing with Doru's company for Castle Ravenloft, roughly three months before Night 1.
how lost: Helped Doru assemble the marchers and joined the company. None returned; no bodies were recovered and no word has been received.

Other members of Doru's company, mostly young adults
status: missing; presumed dead
last seen: departing with Doru and Alanik for Castle Ravenloft, roughly three months before Night 1.
how lost: None returned and no bodies were found. The company numbered about two dozen; the precise count is uncertain.
transcription.source: Foundry JournalEntry.42xzfqzETGhL9bpW.JournalEntryPage.K5xlb3JJQR3MzfJX; compared with image; native-text punctuation and paragraph breaks retained

transcription.text:
Record of the lost and missing — Village of Barovia
Kept by Kolyan Indirovich

Dating convention: the first night of the siege is Night 1. Each night runs from dusk to the following dawn.


Emeric, an older adult villager with graying hair
status: departed for Vallaki; whereabouts unconfirmed
last seen: after Rahadin's proclamation, roughly three months before Night 1, departing west along the Old Svalich Road with the first group bound for Vallaki. Departure witnessed by the burgomaster.
how lost: No word received since departure. It has not been established whether the two travelers later reported killed by wolves belonged to this party.

Magda, a young adult villager
status: departed for Vallaki; whereabouts unconfirmed
last seen: with Emeric's party, on the same road and day.
how lost: No word received since departure.

Franz, an adult widower; wife Alana died of illness before his departure
status: departed for Vallaki; whereabouts unconfirmed
last seen: with Emeric's party, traveling with his two children and his sister Nyanka.
how lost: No word received since departure. Alana's death preceded the departure and was unrelated to the siege.

Fyodor, Franz's son and a child at the time of departure
status: departed for Vallaki; whereabouts unconfirmed
last seen: with his father, sister Myrtle, and aunt Nyanka in Emeric's party.
how lost: No word received since departure.

Myrtle, Franz's daughter and a child at the time of departure
status: departed for Vallaki; whereabouts unconfirmed
last seen: with her father, brother Fyodor, and aunt Nyanka in Emeric's party.
how lost: No word received since departure.

Nyanka, Franz's young adult sister
status: departed for Vallaki; whereabouts unconfirmed
last seen: with Franz and his children in Emeric's party.
how lost: No word received since departure.
transcription.source: Foundry JournalEntry.42xzfqzETGhL9bpW.JournalEntryPage.wDPSvSNOkGtFBTi7; compared with image; native-text punctuation and paragraph breaks retained

transcription.text:
Other members of Emeric's party, up to eighteen villagers of mixed ages
status: departed for Vallaki; whereabouts unconfirmed
last seen: departing west along the Old Svalich Road with Emeric's party, after Rahadin's proclamation and roughly three months before Night 1.
how lost: No word received since departure. The party numbered no more than two dozen; six members are listed above. The exact total is approximate.

transcription.text:
Record of the lost and missing — Village of Barovia
Kept by Kolyan Indirovich

Dating convention: the first night of the siege is Night 1. Each night runs from dusk to the following dawn.


Anton Konstantinovich, Alenka Konstantinova's brother
status: missing
last seen: at home before retiring on Night 4, according to Alenka.
how lost: Alenka reported him missing on the morning after Night 4. The door was undisturbed; no blood, signs of struggle, or body were found. Cause and manner of disappearance unknown.

Dezdrelda Konstaninova, Anton's wife
status: missing
last seen: at home with Anton before retiring on Night 4, according to Alenka.
how lost: Reported missing with her husband on the morning after Night 4. The door was undisturbed; no blood, signs of struggle, or body were found. Cause and manner of disappearance unknown.

Marta, adult sister of Bildrath Cantemir
status: dead
last seen: at home with her husband and son on Night 4.
how lost: According to Bildrath, she chose to stay and defend her home. Killed during the Night 4 attacks.

Dragomir, adult husband of Marta; father of Parriwimple
status: dead
last seen: at home with Marta and their son on Night 4.
how lost: Killed during the Night 4 attacks. Parriwimple survived and is in Bildrath's care.
transcription.source: Foundry JournalEntry.42xzfqzETGhL9bpW.JournalEntryPage.nKwQFiVUpIqZ1YlX; compared with image; native-text punctuation and paragraph breaks retained

transcription.text:
Record of the lost and missing — Village of Barovia
Kept by Ismark Indirovich


Kolyan Indirovich, older adult burgomaster of Barovia; father of Ismark Kolyanovich & Ireena Kolyanovich (adopted)
status: dead
last seen alive: Night 7, at the mansion. Ireena heard him invite a visitor inside before her memory of the night failed.
how lost: Found dead in the first-floor parlor. Kolyan bore one long, clean cut across the chest. Ireena was found unconscious in the same room, alive, with two puncture wounds at her throat. Her account describes a tall, gaunt figure with a deep voice and red eyes. Cause of death: fatal chest wound. Perpetrator unidentified; Strahd is suspected, unconfirmed.

Other villagers and defenders killed in the siege, mixed ages, dozens by rough count
status: dead
last seen: at the barricades, in their homes, and in the streets over the course of the siege.
how lost: Killed in the attacks. Many bodies were visible when the western barricade fell. The exact total remains a rough count.

The undead withdrew after Kolyan's death. The siege ended on Night 7.



Gertruda, Mary's young adult daughter and Doru's betrothed
status: missing
last seen: at home with her mother on Night 6, before they retired, according to Mary. Mary found her gone at dawn after Night 6; the family horse, Nori, was also missing from its stall.
how lost: Mary believed Gertruda had set out alone for Vallaki to seek aid from its burgomaster. Scouts sent to search the western road on the morning after Night 6. Recorded as missing.

Lansten family: two adults and three children (one girl and two boys)
status: missing
last seen: during a zombie attack on Night 7; exact location not recorded.
how lost: Their disappearance was reported on the morning after Night 7. Their fate is unknown.
